# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 engine preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews the Skia m158 engine update without changing the managed binding surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 while retaining the existing managed wrappers and C API declarations. The milestone update itself retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and reserves the .300 package revision bucket rather than upgrading that engine. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduced Skia m158 without managed binding changes. The milestone update retained native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and advanced its package revision to 14.4.0.300.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
